title: Tasks
pitch: A keyboard-first task list whose tasks are plain JSON files, so you, your scripts and your coding agents can all work on them.
description: One TypeScript backend runs the desktop, Android and web apps and a CLI that agents drive over JSON lines. Undo, history and safe retries are built in, and Syncthing keeps devices in step.

externals.name: Syncthing
externals.note: The web version keeps your tasks in this browser only; the desktop and Android apps keep them as files you can sync.
